description: Eval-only held-out-datasets suite: 24 whole dataset families of a public multi-task collection, held out of the private training component tasksource-v1 (part of sft-v2) and never trained on. Private: the text is in the private evaluation mirror and the family list in the private manifest; this public manifest carries hashes and counts only (Jared's decision, 2026-09-26).

roles.test: locked; read once per registered confirmation (--allow-test)

records_per_family: 100 per partition (a few families have slightly fewer after the evaluation-side screen)
sources_note: the 24 families (record sources 'tasksource:<family>') are listed only in the private manifest. Rows written by kev.benchmark carry those sources, so this suite's rows.json and per-source reports stay in the private dataset (scripts/private_rows.py), like sft-v1's. No source is listed here, so this suite cannot serve as a temperature pool read (kev.rounds refuses a pool it cannot check).

context.note: admitted in kev.model.training_context(MAX_TRAIN_STATE) (PR #149: 65,536 state tokens); states are short (max 1,969 tokens)

label_policy: tasksource's native labels, vote shares and exact posteriors, recast by tasksource's own deterministic code; no model labels anything here. Sources whose text or labels come from closed or undisclosed models are excluded (open-weight-only policy).
screen: every record was screened against every Kev training partition (dropped when a Kev training record overlaps it or repeats its state); sft-v2's training records are screened against both partitions (evals/sft-v2/manifest.json)
